1 (intro): must include that information in some form, feel free to animate/add more text or info or whatever. Maybe add a trigger warning for demonic possession?

2: Dipper sits on his window seat in front of the window, looking angry at his laptop. Zoom in on him as he continues to type. He thinks bitterly of his sister Mabel, with whom he recently had a fight. (she can be in some sort of hazy thought bubble)(Dipper has no ghost outline yet)

3: Fed up with his laptop not working, he leans his head against the window and lets out a frustrated sigh.

4: A strange hand is extended to him. He takes a moment to notice it, and looks scared when he does. However, he gives in and shakes the Bill's hand, looking more determined.

5: Whatever sort of transition you want to do. Preferably fits nice with part 4. It's flashy and dramatic, but also foreboding.

6: (Dipper now has his ghost outline that's shown in the ref). Dipper lays on the ground for a moment. He groans, shakes himself awake, and remembers what happened. He turns around, yelling out in fear.

7: Bill inhabiting Dipper's body (henceforth referred to as "Bipper") stands dramatically in front of the window with a wide demonic grin. Dipper, still on the ground, is terrified.

8: Dipper watches in shock and horror as Bipper strides past him.

9: Dipper pushes off the ground, floating due to his new ghost-ness. He watches Bipper leave down the staircase, then follows through the floor. Include some transition to the stage.

10: On stage, Mabel happily shows off her sock puppet. Feel free to add another shot, there's some extra time at the end but I couldn't think of anything that didn't wreck the flow into the next part.

11: Mabel puts the puppet on her left paw, oblivious to Bipper stalking behind her. Bipper walks around the stage threateningly, working his way around to the wings, hiding behind the cardboard bushes.

12: Mabel is startled as a shadow crosses over her. 180 camera turn to see Bipper standing center stage, looming over her. The lights are behind him, casting a dramatic shadow over his entire body. He looks eager and confident and scary.

13: Bipper reaches out a paw, signaling that he wants her to give him Dipper's journal. Mabel holds the book close to her, then slowly extends it to give it to Bipper. She looks hesitant and regretful.

14: Extreme close-up of Bipper's insanity. His smile is uncomfortably wide and his eyes are gleaming with excitement.

15: "One thing you didn't see coming..." Mabel changes her mind and pulls the book away from him. She looks more confident now. Bipper still reaches towards her in shock. Mabel hotly defends her brother, and he appears in a word bubble looking happy and loveable.

16: Camera shot from floor, to increase the tension between Mabel and Bipper. You can add her taking a step away from him or him stretching his claws if you want.

17: "And now he's all alone," the line that once referred to Dipper, now refers to Bipper. He feels threatened. He looks mad, but his pupils shift back and forth and he's trying really hard not to look scared and desperate.

18: Suddenly (we don't see Mabel jump, so seeing her appear in frame feels sudden) Mabel leaps onto Bipper, who is surprised. She slams Bipper against the floor, holding his shoulders down as he  cries out in fear and anger. His hat falls off (representing his loss of power), and stays off for the remainder of the song.

19: Mabel looms over Bipper (low camera angle feels threatening), and Dipper floats over to join her. They look confident and strong.

20: Bipper makes a desperate lunge for Mabel, who grits her teeth, grabs his forearm, and slams him down once more. Bipper stays on the ground at her paws.

21: Dipper eagerly throws himself into Bipper's (his) body. There is a flash similar to the one in part 5.

22: Dipper, on the ground with his eyes closed, no longer has his ghost outline. He looks up and Mabel runs over happily. Their eyes are shining in a happy sibling reunion moment.

23: They talk for a moment, the mood fading.

24: The mood is more somber. Mabel is apologetic for their fight and for almost giving in to Bill, while Dipper is just plain exhausted from Bill inhabiting his body. However, he surprises her and reaches up for a hug.

25: They hug, the Mystery Twins back together, and the screen fades out.

Credits: I'll handle those, dw ;)
